enrichment method: To identify the circNEIL3-interacting protein, we performed RNA pull-down assays after transfecting into cells with biotin-labeled sense (S) or antisense (AS) DNA oligomers crossing the junction site of circNEIL3
fractionation method: the pull-down proteins were subjected to Sodium Dodecyl Sulfate PolyAcrylamide Gel Electrophoresis (SDS-PAGE) and Coomassie blue staining.
labeling: Mass spectrometry analysis identified the ~45 kDa of band as the RNA-binding protein YBX1
